correctness.rationale: For area-normalized spherical harmonics, the reference-equator order-j coefficient is the normalized associated Legendre value. Schur orthogonality gives the diagonal normal spectrum; parity makes orders 2 and 3 complementary for all degrees at least two. The exact multipliers are products of central-binomial ratios divided by four pi. After the weight degree plus one-half, both parity subsequences strictly decrease because the rational recurrence denominator exceeds its numerator by exactly \(4j^2-1\); Stirling gives the sharp infimum 1/(2π²), while the degree-three maximum is 35/(128π). Smooth convex support functions realize every single-degree ratio by sufficiently small spherical-harmonic perturbations of a ball. The packaged checker passed 2006 reproducibility checks, and the infinite proof does not rely on finite enumeration.
